thread:
Emma (Partner Ops): quick heads-up — marketplace partners reporting tail latency and a small regression after the latest CUDA/driver roll (customers on pinned v2 images)
Raj (Eng - Runtime): saw the report, repro locally on a small perf test. failing op: fused_attention_backward in quant path. stack: `cudaErrorInvalidDeviceFunction` in logs
Mika (HW Partner): we pushed driver 535.x to the partner lab last week. can you paste the exact driver/cuda combo? we tested on 535.43 + CUDA 12.2rc but ok to re-check
Raj (Eng - Runtime): repro environment: driver=535.54, cuda=12.2. happens on Ampere with certain nvcc flags + tensorcore fused kernels
Zoe (Marketplace PM): we have a joint announcement scheduled Tue for the marketplace integration. if this impacts listed images we need to pin or delay the announcement. what's the safe fallback? :grimacing:
Luis (Platform Eng): quick mitigation: we can add a marketplace image tag that pins driver to 535.43 and cuda runtime 12.1. that avoids the fused kernel path. rollout is a simple image tag swap for affected SKUs
Maria (SRE): add synthetic traffic to the canary before we flip. checks: p50/p95 latency, error rate, and `cudaError*` count. I can wire alerts to PagerDuty if thresholds breach
Mika (HW Partner): interesting — our QA harness didn't hit the regression because it uses mixed-precision path disabled. can you share the failing config?
Raj (Eng - Runtime): attaching snippet (paste):
```
# repro snippet
MODEL_BATCH=1
SEQ_LEN=2048
QUANT=bitsandbytes
KERNEL_FLAGS="--use-fused-attn-backward"
run_inference --model x --seq $SEQ_LEN --batch $MODEL_BATCH
```
It fails with `InvalidDeviceFunction` on the fused kernel invocation
Emma (Partner Ops): action items: 1) Raj/Luis build a pinned image tag and smoke test by EOD, 2) Mika to validate on partner lab config, 3) Maria to wire canary checks and PD alerts, 4) Zoe to hold announcement if green not confirmed by tomorrow 09:00 PT
Luis (Platform Eng): working on the image tag now. planning to push `marketplace-53543-cuda12.1-pin` and create a canary route. ETA 3h
Raj (Eng - Runtime): quick patch idea — fall back to unfused kernel when fused fails at runtime (try/catch around kernel launch). low-risk and can be toggled by env var `REDWOOD_FORCE_UNFUSED=1`
Mika (HW Partner): we'll run the repro with the pinned image and report back. can you expose the env var in image so customers can toggle?
Luis (Platform Eng): yes, will include env toggle and document in marketplace notes. also adding an ops rollback playbook (one-line rollback to previous image tag)
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: marketplace/pinned-image/canary -> starting in ~2h. CI: passing, smoke: pending
Maria (SRE): once canary starts, I'll populate the dashboard and add Grafana panels for `cuda_error_count` and kernel fallback rate
Zoe (Marketplace PM): thanks team. I'll tentatively postpone the public announcement until we confirm green. I'll also notify the partner comms channel and legal about the hold
Emma (Partner Ops): thanks — please update this thread as you hit checkpoints. if we get green before 9am PT we keep the announcement, otherwise we delay. :thumbsup:
